title: Adversarial Trust Poisoning in Vehicular Collaborative Perception
abstract: arXiv:2605.22122v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Collaborative perception (CP) enables connected and autonomous vehicles to share sensor data and jointly reason about their environment. To defend against adversaries that fabricate or manipulate shared data, existing systems employ cross-vehicle inconsistency detection and trust estimation, penalizing vehicles whose observations conflict with the majority. In this work, we show that these defenses themselves introduce a new attack surface. We present TrustFlip, a novel attack that weaponizes consistency-based defenses to poison the trust assigned to benign vehicles. Instead of injecting false data into the collaboration pipeline, it deploys physical adversarial objects that are genuine but induce inconsistent observations among benign vehicles. translated_title: 车载协同感知中的对抗性信任投毒攻击
translated_abstract: 协同感知（CP）使网联自动驾驶车辆能够共享传感器数据并对环境进行联合推理。为了防御伪造或篡改共享数据的攻击者，现有系统采用跨车辆不一致性检测和信任估计机制，惩罚那些观测结果与大多数车辆相冲突的车辆。在本研究中，我们证明了这些防御机制本身会引入新的攻击面。我们提出了TrustFlip，一种新颖的攻击方法，它将基于一致性的防御武器化，用于毒化分配给良性车辆的信任值。与向协同感知流程中注入虚假数据不同，该攻击部署了物理对抗物体，这些物体是真实存在的，但会在良性车辆之间引发不一致的观测结果。由此产生的不一致性会被防御机制错误地归因于目标车辆，导致其信任分数不断下降，最终使其被降权或排除出协同感知。
tldr: 本文提出TrustFlip攻击，通过部署真实存在但会在良性车辆间引发观测不一致的物理对抗物体，将基于一致性的防御机制武器化，使防御系统将不一致性错误归因于目标车辆，从而毒化其信任分数并最终导致其被降权或排除出协同感知。
en_tdlr: This paper presents TrustFlip, a novel attack that deploys genuine physical adversarial objects to induce inconsistent observations among benign vehicles, weaponizing consistency-based defenses to misattribute these inconsistencies to a targeted vehicle, thereby poisoning its trust score and leading to its downweighting or exclusion from collaborative perception.
